violations.observation: Observed ceiling light in kitchen in need of replacement bulb.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location. Observed 2024 food establishment permit.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. CFM will request copy of 2025 food permit from [county email]

violations.title: Cooking Raw Animal Foods, Minimum of 155F
violations.observation: The following comminuted or ground meat, fish, or game animal was not cooked to a sufficient temperature and/or time to eliminate pathogenic bacteria: beef burger patty observed at 144F from broiler.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods such as ratites, injected meats, comminuted meats, commercially raised game animals, and raw eggs not for immediate consumption shall be cooked to a minimum internal temperature of 155F for at least 15 seconds. CFM discarded patties. CFM adjusted conveyor belt time. Patty observed at 159F.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: observed sliced tomatoes in covered stainless steel container stored on false bottom insert at 46F.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. EHS recommended not using false bottom insert and to cool tomatoes without cover to facilitate faster cooling. Cover removed.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present along the roof access hatch. Observed roof access hatch ajar. CFM stated hatch can open.
violations.corrective_action: EHS recommended closing hatch to secure facility from pest entry. Ensure hatch lock is not broken or in need of repair.

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present along the entrance doors.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. Install door sweeps on doors.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. Observed unapproved backflow prevention device installed on mop faucet.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS will provide approved backflow prevention device product information to CFM. CFM to purchase and proof receipt to EHS within 3 days. Install upon arrival.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections at the mop sink piping are leaking.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. CFM will place a work order to repair mop sink.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections under the hand sink next to the office are leaking.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. CFM will place work order to repair hand sink.
